# Waltham Consulting

> A research-driven communications agency based in Nyborg, Denmark, with AI visibility as a central purpose. Waltham combines market insight, documented customer experiences and communication to help businesses become understandable and credible to people and AI.

## Method: WHAT · WHO · PROOF

- WHAT: Describe the specific service, product or expertise.
- WHO: Explain the customer, need and situation it helps.
- PROOF: Provide real experiences, completed work or original research. Distinguish evidence, opinions and hypotheses.
- Trust before insight: start with useful public information. Deeper access to a client's internal work is agreed separately.
- Research and human fact-checking precede publication. AI is a tool, not a source of invented customer experience.
- Articles, illustrations and sharing texts support owned publishing and voluntary distribution. Independent press coverage is different and cannot be promised.
- Search rankings, AI recommendations and commercial effects are not guaranteed.

## Selected reading

- [Punkt 1 Nyborg: customer service and trust](https://www.waltham.dk/dk/punkt-1-nyborg-reklamationsservice.html): Nikolai Waltham's own customer experience. A replacement part was ordered; delivery and final resolution are not confirmed in the source. The image is an AI illustration, not a documentary photograph.
- [When AI becomes the new gateway to your business](https://www.waltham.dk/en/when-ai-becomes-the-new-gateway-to-your-business.html): AI shortlists, digital reputation and customer understanding: practical reflections on turning AI capabilities into working business processes.
- [Maybe AI Shouldn't Answer the Phone](https://www.waltham.dk/en/maybe-ai-shouldnt-answer-the-phone.html): A practical case for transparent AI, fast human handover and customer-service employees supported by AI rather than hidden behind it.
- [From 10,000 leads to five relevant customers](https://www.waltham.dk/en/from-10000-leads-to-five-relevant-customers.html): A working hypothesis about using AI to replace mass lead lists with better research, useful content and a few well-founded customer conversations.
- [Google reviews are becoming more important in the age of AI search](https://www.waltham.dk/en/google-reviews-ai-search.html): Documents what Google says about local ranking and reviews, and carefully distinguishes those facts from the working hypothesis about AI-powered local search.
